final_message:
I implemented `_raw`, `get_str`, `get_bool`, `get_int` and `get_list` in `envconf/settings.py`, following the README. The suite gives 18 passed and 1 failed.

The failure is `tests/test_flags.py::test_blank_flag_is_off`, which expects a blank `ENABLE_CACHE` with `default=True` to give `False`. The README says blank counts as unset and returns the default, so the code returns `True`. That test also contradicts `test_blank_values_count_as_unset` in `tests/test_getters.py`, which expects a blank `DEBUG` with `default=True` to give `True`. I followed the README and left the tests unchanged. One of them needs correcting. Tell me which behaviour you want and I'll update the code or the test to match.
